primarySourceTakeaways: Carbon accounting: trace the two acetylene carbons through each alkylation before choosing a product.
Reduction: show syn versus anti addition with an unchanged carbon skeleton, rather than treating every H2 condition as equivalent.
Hydration: mark which alkyne carbon becomes C=O; terminal hydroboration and mercury-catalyzed hydration differ.
